views.heading: Slit view (optic section, cornea and chamber)
Fundus view (90D lens, optic disc)
views.label: Fundus through a 90D lens, dilated: optic disc and macula

prompts.prompt: 56-year-old man with early primary open-angle glaucoma in the right eye, found at a routine check. No symptoms. Vertical cup-to-disc ratio about 0.6 with slight inferior rim thinning.
64-year-old man with moderate primary open-angle glaucoma in the right eye. No pain or redness. Vertical cup-to-disc ratio about 0.75 with an inferotemporal notch.
75-year-old woman with advanced primary open-angle glaucoma in the left eye. Tunnel vision that she keeps bumping into things with. Cup-to-disc ratio about 0.9, a pale disc and almost no rim.
68-year-old woman with primary open-angle glaucoma in the right eye and a splinter haemorrhage at the inferior disc margin, seen for the first time at this visit. No symptoms.

intended.diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma with a disc haemorrhage

prompts.prompt: 61-year-old man with primary open-angle glaucoma in the left eye and a deep focal notch of the inferior rim, while the rest of the rim is well preserved.

intended.diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma with a focal notch

prompts.prompt: 63-year-old woman with normal-tension glaucoma in the right eye. Eye pressure has always been 14 to 16 mmHg, with a large vertical cup, a notch and a disc haemorrhage. She has migraines and cold hands.
45-year-old man with high myopia of -9 dioptres and open-angle glaucoma in the right eye. A tilted disc with wide peripapillary atrophy and a large cup.

intended.diagnosis: Open-angle glaucoma with a myopic tilted disc

prompts.description: Ocular hypertension with a healthy disc
prompts.prompt: 52-year-old woman with ocular hypertension in the left eye. Eye pressure 26 mmHg, with an open angle, a healthy rim and a cup-to-disc ratio of 0.3.
19-year-old man with juvenile open-angle glaucoma in the right eye and a strong family history. Eye pressure 38 mmHg, an enlarged cup and no pain.

prompts.description: End-stage glaucoma with a white disc
prompts.prompt: 81-year-old woman with end-stage glaucoma in the left eye, with only light perception left. A totally cupped white disc with no visible rim.

prompts.description: POAG in dark skin and a dark brown iris
prompts.prompt: 58-year-old man of West African descent with dark skin and dark brown irides, and moderate primary open-angle glaucoma in the right eye. A large oval cup and a thin inferior rim.

prompts.description: POAG in fair skin and a blue iris
prompts.prompt: 70-year-old woman of Scandinavian descent with fair skin and pale blue irides, and moderate primary open-angle glaucoma in the left eye. Peripapillary atrophy and a thin rim.

62-year-old woman with an acute angle-closure attack in the right eye, starting yesterday evening. Severe eye pain, headache, vomiting and haloes around lights. Red eye, steamy cornea and a fixed mid-dilated pupil.

prompts.description: Acute angle closure in a man with dark skin
prompts.prompt: 67-year-old man with dark skin and dark brown irides, and acute angle closure in the left eye. Sudden pain and blurred vision after an evening at the cinema. Ciliary flush, hazy cornea and a very shallow chamber.

prompts.description: Angle-closure attack after treatment, with glaukomflecken
prompts.prompt: 66-year-old woman two weeks after an acute angle-closure attack in the right eye, now treated. The eye is white and comfortable, with white anterior subcapsular flecks (glaukomflecken) on the lens and a mid-dilated, poorly reacting pupil.

intended.diagnosis: Resolved acute angle closure with glaukomflecken

prompts.prompt: 59-year-old woman with intermittent angle closure in the left eye. Brief evening episodes of blur and haloes that settle after sleep. Today the eye is quiet with a shallow chamber and a slight corneal haze.
71-year-old man with chronic angle-closure glaucoma in the right eye. No pain. A quiet white eye, a shallow chamber with a forward iris, and an enlarged cup with rim thinning.
55-year-old woman with long sight and a narrow angle in the left eye. No symptoms, normal eye pressure and a healthy disc, but a shallow peripheral chamber.
42-year-old woman with plateau iris in the right eye and a patent iridotomy. A normal central chamber depth, a flat iris and a narrow angle at the periphery.
76-year-old woman with phacomorphic glaucoma in the right eye. A swollen white cataract has pushed the iris forward. Painful red eye, hazy cornea and a very shallow chamber.
82-year-old man with phacolytic glaucoma in the left eye. A hypermature cataract is leaking protein. Painful red eye, hazy cornea, a deep chamber with heavy flare and white cells floating in it.

64-year-old woman with malignant glaucoma in the right eye, three days after a trabeculectomy. Painful eye, very high pressure and a flat central and peripheral anterior chamber, with a patent iridotomy.

73-year-old woman with pseudoexfoliation glaucoma in the left eye. Grey-white flaky material in a target pattern on the front of the lens and at the pupil margin, a poorly dilating pupil and a large cup.

34-year-old man with myopia and pigmentary glaucoma in the right eye. A vertical brown pigment line on the back of the cornea (Krukenberg spindle), spoke-like iris transillumination and an enlarged cup. Blurred vision after running.
27-year-old man who has used steroid eye drops for vernal allergy for two years, with steroid-induced glaucoma in the left eye. A quiet eye, eye pressure 34 mmHg and an enlarged cup.
69-year-old man with diabetes and neovascular glaucoma in the right eye. Fine new vessels on the iris and at the pupil margin, a painful red eye, a hazy cornea and a mid-dilated pupil.
41-year-old woman with uveitic glaucoma in the left eye. Red eye with keratic precipitates, flare and cells in the chamber, adhesions at the pupil and eye pressure of 36 mmHg.
37-year-old man with Posner-Schlossman syndrome in the right eye. Mild discomfort and haloes, a white eye, a few fine keratic precipitates, slight corneal haze and eye pressure of 48 mmHg.
39-year-old woman with Fuchs heterochromic cyclitis and glaucoma in the left eye. A paler iris than the other eye, fine stellate keratic precipitates and a quiet white eye.
48-year-old man with angle-recession glaucoma in the right eye, 15 years after being hit by a cricket ball. A slightly irregular pupil, a deeper chamber than the other eye and an enlarged cup.
22-year-old man hit in the left eye by a squash ball two days ago. A 3 mm layered hyphaema, a hazy cornea, pain and eye pressure of 42 mmHg.

intended.diagnosis: Traumatic hyphaema with raised intraocular pressure

prompts.prompt: 60-year-old man with ghost-cell glaucoma in the right eye, three weeks after a vitreous haemorrhage. Tan-coloured cells layered in the lower chamber, a red painful eye and eye pressure of 44 mmHg.
44-year-old woman with iridocorneal endothelial syndrome in the left eye. A displaced, distorted pupil with holes in the iris, a slightly hazy cornea and raised eye pressure.
16-year-old girl with Sturge-Weber syndrome and glaucoma in the right eye. A port-wine stain on the upper lid and forehead, dilated episcleral vessels and an enlarged cup.
12-year-old boy with Axenfeld-Rieger syndrome and glaucoma in the left eye. A white line at the corneal edge, a thin iris with an off-centre pupil and an enlarged cup.
Six-month-old boy with primary congenital glaucoma in the right eye. An enlarged cloudy cornea with breaks in its back layer, watering, light sensitivity and an enlarged eye.

prompts.description: Raised episcleral pressure in thyroid eye disease
prompts.prompt: 53-year-old woman with thyroid eye disease and secondary glaucoma in the left eye. A bulging eye, a retracted upper lid, dilated vessels over the muscle insertions and an enlarged cup.

intended.diagnosis: Secondary glaucoma in thyroid eye disease

prompts.prompt: 47-year-old man with a carotid-cavernous fistula and raised eye pressure in the right eye, six weeks after a head injury. Corkscrew dilated vessels over the white of the eye, a bulging eye and a swishing noise in the head.

intended.diagnosis: Carotid-cavernous fistula with raised episcleral venous pressure

prompts.prompt: 72-year-old woman with glaucoma in the left eye, one year after a trabeculectomy. A raised pale bleb under the upper lid, a small peripheral iridectomy, a quiet eye and a large cup.

intended.diagnosis: Glaucoma after trabeculectomy with a functioning bleb

prompts.prompt: 65-year-old man with lens-particle glaucoma in the right eye, ten days after complicated cataract surgery. White fluffy lens fragments in the chamber, a red eye, a hazy cornea and eye pressure of 40 mmHg.
